kind: secondary motion lifecycle design sources; compared independently from visual game references

sources.adopted: Distinguish teleport/presentation discontinuities from ordinary movement instead of carrying prior simulation motion into the new state.
Use explicit owner lifecycle reset for teleport and time skips; this project calls its existing spring reset and does not add either engine solver.
Physics-bone systems also document reset at teleport boundaries; no renderer synchronization or solver replacement.
Five retained and actually viewed same-genre game image sources; only silhouette and restrained clothing motion comparisons, no inferred hidden implementation.
